tessellation.decimation: quadric; target 3000 faces, doubling until sampled bidirectional surface error <=0.75mm and bounds error <=0.5mm; sampling seed 0
tessellation.error_scope: Sampled error relative to tessellation, not an analytic CAD Hausdorff bound.
